description: This file is a Node.js script that analyzes Linux browser dependencies for Playwright browsers, identifying missing libraries, mapping them to packages, and resolving ambiguities through user input.

methods.name: pickPackage
methods.description: Selects an appropriate package for a missing library, filtering out debug, test, and dev packages, and matching by prefix.

methods.name: findPackages
methods.description: Uses 'apt-file' to search for packages providing a specific library.

methods.name: fileDependencies
methods.description: Runs 'ldd' on a file to list its dependencies.

methods.name: missingFileDependencies
methods.description: Filters dependencies to find missing libraries.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes a system command and returns its output.

methods.name: getDistributionName
methods.description: Reads '/etc/os-release' to determine the Linux distribution name.

methods.name: currentTime
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted as 'Month Day, Year'.
